title: RunEvent
description: One record of a run, in the order the runtime wrote it. The runtime's own record is carried unchanged, as an opaque document; the daemon adds the run, the sequence number and the time. The sequence number only grows per run: it is the stream's event id, and a client resumes after the last one it saw.

sequence.description: 1 for a run's first event; each later event has a larger number. The runs of one session or of the whole daemon have no common order: a sequence number is per run.

record.description: The runtime's record, byte for byte as a document; no secret appears in it (design sheet, decision 10).

sdc.daemon.EventId.title: EventId
sdc.daemon.EventId.description: The id the daemon gives a recorded event; the stream's own id is the run's sequence number.

sdc.daemon.EventKind.title: EventKind
sdc.daemon.EventKind.description: The kind of the runtime's record, copied from it. UNMAPPED: the runtime's record kinds are Loom's and are not known here; the daemon does not interpret them.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run, chosen by the submitting client (a UUID it generated, or any unique text). The state directory of the run is named after it. UNMAPPED: the design sheet leaves open whether the client or the daemon mints the id; the client chooses here so that a retried submit names the same run and a scenario can name it. A daemon-minted id needs a typed response and `{generated: true}`. UNMAPPED: a submit with an id that is already taken is not refused in this model (see SubmitRun).
